title: Height Difference Filter Feature
description: Filters away positions based on the heightmap around the placement position.The filter will check for surface blocks in each cardinal direction within the `search_radius`. Each block will be checked against all given conditions.

places_block.title: Places Block
places_block.description: Reference to the block to be placed.

randomize_rotation.title: Randomize Rotation
randomize_rotation.description: If true, randomize the block's cardinal direction.

enforce_placement_rules.title: Enforce Placement Rules
enforce_placement_rules.description: If true, enforce the block's placement rule check.

may_replace.title: May Replace
may_replace.description: A list of blocks that may be replaced during placement. Omit this field to allow any block to be replaced.
